name: webos-iptv-player
comment:browserslist: The gate's target = the FLOOR of the supported fleet: webOS 4 = Chromium 53. Drives stylelint/doiuse (CSS) and eslint-plugin-compat (JS APIs); esbuild uses its own 'chrome53' syntax target. A static gate can only check the floor (eslint-plugin-compat flags not-yet-added APIs, NOT ones removed by newer engines), so forward-compat on newer TVs is left to the Playwright e2e, which runs on a current Chromium.
comment:@mdn/browser-compat-data: Pinned exact, and declared even though eslint-plugin-compat already pulls it in: scripts/chromium-53-simulation.mjs derives the chromium-53-simulation removal set from it, so a floating range would change what the e2e suite deletes on any lockfile refresh, with no code change to review. Two versions exist in the tree (eslint-plugin-compat's and ast-metadata-inferer's); this makes which one we resolve explicit rather than a hoisting accident.

scripts.service:build: rm -rf build/bundled-service && tsc -p bundled-service/tsconfig.json && node scripts/service-compat-gate.mjs build/bundled-service
scripts.preview: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs --preview && node scripts/serve.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:css && npm run lint:js
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && vitest run && playwright test
scripts.benchmark: npm run benchmark:typecheck && npm run benchmark:parser-build && playwright test --config benchmarks/playwright.config.ts
